latestVersion.changelog:
golang-modernize 1.1.4

- Updated workflow to check the latest Go version using the Go Version Changelogs section (not by live fetch) and improved upgrade suggestion guidance.
- Modernization workflow now instructs to run `go mod tidy` and test suite before updating dependencies, and to prompt for changelog review.
- Clarified Go Version Changelogs table instructions; for versions newer than 1.26, instructs to consult official release notes.
- Minor content and formatting improvements to modernization steps and guidance.
- Version bump to 1.1.4 in skill metadata.
